description: Renders JPEG stills of a film at given seconds, to look at before a full render. Returns the file paths. With sheet=true it also makes one contact sheet and returns it as an image, which is cheaper to look at than many stills.

demo.description: Folder that holds the film's index.html (absolute path, or relative to the library root).

q.description: Query string passed to the page as location.search, e.g. 'lang=en&cut=b'.

sheet.description: Also make a contact sheet (needs the Python environment) and return it inline.

size.description: Frame size WxH, even numbers. Default 1920x1080; 1080x1920 for a vertical Short.

name: render_stills
title: Render review stills
